title: The first kart.
body: At six, AMER discovered karting — turning a childhood curiosity into something of his own.
alt: AMER in kart overalls in the paddock, aged six

title: Junior titles.
body: Back-to-back regional karting championships turned promise into a reputation.
alt: AMER holding a karting trophy at sunset

title: Finding his people.
body: AMER joined a privateer race outfit, marking his first major step into professional motorsport.
alt: AMER signing with the junior team

title: Touring cars.
body: A dominant touring-car campaign proved the saloon, not the kart, was where AMER belonged.
alt: AMER beside a touring car in the garage

title: The year everything changed.
body: Time-attack brought AMER into the spotlight, while the team confirmed him as their lead driver.
alt: AMER walking the pit lane in team kit

title: Building the F10.
body: A full winter of developing the BMW F10 535i laid the foundation for a 2026 campaign.
alt: AMER in the garage beside the BMW F10

title: From karts to the top.
body: AMER is now racing at the sharp end, with the paddock still his anchor — family, home and life beyond racing.
